scorecard.behavior: relia ingest --input accepts local JSON objects, JSON arrays, {"events": [...]} objects, and JSONL streams without network or credentials.

Input events are recursively redacted and entropy-scanned before experience shard writes; known token shapes are redacted and unclassified high-entropy values fail closed with exit 6 without creating a shard.
Persisted experience records require a positive PR number and at least one https://github.com/ provenance URL; missing or invalid provenance returns exit 9.
relia check rejects memory rules that lack experience citations or PR provenance, so uncited rules cannot pass validation.

Normalized records follow schemas/experience-record.schema.json, default to org_eligible false and private share scope, and are idempotently upserted into monthly .relia/experiences/YYYY-MM.jsonl shards.
Agent attribution is captured from explicit event fields or inferred from configured PR labels, coauthor trailers, and bot logins; uncertain attribution is excluded by default.
make prepush-full passes with lint, fast tests, coverage, and contract validation after the T3 regression test and evidence updates.
